cancellation: 100% full refund if cancelled up to 48 hours prior to check-in. Cancellations within 48 hours are non-refundable.
idRules: Valid government-issued photo ID required for every adult guest (Aadhaar, Passport, Driving License, or Voter ID).
Physical or original DigiLocker verification accepted.
coupleRules: Couples are welcomed with valid individual photo ID proofs.
childRules: Children under 6 years stay free with existing bedding.
